belay.1: Bolted anchor with newer hangers at the top of the thin flake; one 60 m rope reaches the ground from it.
belay.2: Bolted anchor just above the short balancy slab that ends the pitch.
belay.3: Bolted rappel anchor at the top of the pitch; the rappel back to the pitch 2 anchor is not plumb and angles toward the gully.
